responsibility: This file implements an RTL pass that inserts explicit initializations for pseudo registers proven to be definitely uninitialized at a use. Using dataflow liveness information, it scans each basic block for pseudo uses that are live from inside the block but have no reaching external def, emits a clobber and usually a move from CONST0_RTX immediately before the first such use, and avoids duplicating initializations for repeated subreg-related uses. Its responsibility is late cleanup of must-uninitialized pseudos to stabilize later backend processing and diagnostics, not source-language variable initialization semantics.
